author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
How do you best straddle the line between meditative and inattentive? Is it possible to earn a living from making? Do you have a comfort build? How do I break the ADHD cycle of getting a new hobby, spending money on it, becoming overwhelmed and abandoning it only to acquire another new hobby? In this live stream excerpt Adam Savage answers these questions from Tested members ryanmassey, themeandrousengineer, ryan_j_peck and GMPhil, whom we thank for their support!

02:28 Money from Art
06:16 Comfort Build
07:18 ADHD Hobby
